en-US.whatsNew:
• A refreshed native experience for iPhone and iPad.
• Follow agent conversations, manage sessions, and respond to requests from your devices.
• Open Web file previews in your default browser.
• Project and directory pickers now follow the same ordering as the Web app.
• Improved approval card appearance and Markdown table layout.
